issues: 调试标题 "TAPE SCROLL · FIXED POINTER"，读数卡顶部是灰色骨架条，读数没有指标名和单位
慢爬段线性匀速在 f55 直接接 in-out 冲刺段，速度先归零再起步；刹车回摆是两段 interpolate 拼接，有折点
冲刺峰值约 50px/f 的刻度带完全锐利，读不出速度；读数数字非等宽
刻度带是浅灰面板 + 2px 灰边，取景窗 5px 实心琥珀框，平面线框质感；没有导出时长，按 150f 渲染
changes: 与同卡 NeedleSweep 统一为暗场仪表：深色柔光背景 + 颗粒；刻度带做成内凹深色滚筒（内阴影 + 上下边缘渐隐），白色刻度、tabular 数字
取景窗改为 2px 琥珀发丝框 + 淡琥珀玻璃 + 外柔光，指针为圆角发光三角；调试标题换成左侧 “Capacity · us-east-1 / Rate limit” 标题区
运动重排为一条速度连续的曲线：慢爬 10f 柔起步再巡航，冲刺段用 Hermite 以慢爬末速起步、到 442 速度归零，接按“回摆到 415”反算阻尼的弹簧落定 420，f104 起锁死
冲刺段刻度带按速度做纵向方向性运动模糊（SpeedBlur），读数同步纵向虚化，停下即清晰
读数卡加 REQUESTS / MIN 标题、k 单位与落定后 overshoot 弹出的 ▲ 200% 胶囊；补导出 TAPE_SCROLL_FIXED_POINTER_DURATION = 140
issuesEn: Debug title "TAPE SCROLL · FIXED POINTER", a grey skeleton bar on the readout card, and no metric name or unit
The linear crawl handed straight into an in-out sprint at f55 so speed dropped to zero and restarted; the brake bounce was two stitched interpolates with a kink
At ~50px/f the tape stayed perfectly sharp with no sense of speed; readout digits were proportional
A light grey tape panel with a 2px grey border and a 5px solid amber window read as a flat wireframe; no duration export, so it rendered at 150f
changesEn: Unified with NeedleSweep as a dark instrument: tinted dark backdrop with grain; the tape is a recessed dark drum (inner shadow, top/bottom fade) with white ticks and tabular numbers
Window is a 2px amber hairline frame with faint amber glass and outer glow; pointer is a rounded glowing triangle; the debug title became a left-side "Capacity · us-east-1 / Rate limit" header

Motion is one velocity-continuous curve: a 10f soft start into the crawl, a Hermite sprint that begins at the crawl speed and reaches 442 at zero velocity, then a spring solved to dip to 415 before settling at 420, locked from f104
During the sprint the tape gets vertical directional motion blur (SpeedBlur) and the readout blurs in sync, snapping sharp at rest
Readout card gains a REQUESTS / MIN label, a k unit and a ▲ 200% pill that pops in after landing; exported TAPE_SCROLL_FIXED_POINTER_DURATION = 140
